zh: 没有大堂，没有前台。私人电梯识别了他的手机：欢迎回家，ADRIAN VALE。
“叮。”落地窗从一侧铺到另一侧，整个曼哈顿装进了窗框。客厅能塞下他原来的公寓五次。
Adrian站在玄关没动。鞋底还沾着早上旧街的灰。家——这个词比这套房子还贵。
走到主卫门口，Adrian踩上一块湿瓷砖，脚下一滑。
Roman从身后一把圈住他，一手扣在腰侧，一手横过胸口，把他整个人拉回怀里。
Adrian不但没动，还往后靠了一点。
Roman沉默两秒，耳尖红得厉害。走廊那头有人敲门框，他才退开半步。
工作人员退出去以后，顶层安静得有回声。Roman戴回耳机，转身要去做下一轮检查。

zh.title: 新关系目标
zh.txt: 让Roman为了你，而不是为了工作，主动留下来一次。

zh.title: 关系目标
zh.hint: 钱唯一不能立刻买到的东西，偏偏是他。他要走了。

then: 你能留一下吗？不是工作。

then.hint: 他问你能不能留下。不是工作。你已经很多年没被这样问过了。

opts.t: ……先查完卧室。
二十分钟。
Roman摘下了一边耳机。

then: Vale先生的安保主管说，他得先查卧室。

zh: 门在身后合上，客厅的声音消失了。第一次，只剩他们两个。
Roman脱下外套，挽起袖口，一样样检查窗锁、通风口、床头灯。

zh.hint: 门关着，没人会进来。十七岁那晚没说完的话，终于有了一个够大的房间。

opts.t: Adrian站起来，伸手抓住他的领带。
then: 丝质领带在指间收紧，Roman被迫低下头。他颈侧的脉搏跳得很清楚。

then.hint: 他攥着你的领带。你只要再低一寸。

opts.t: 我现在再多说一句，可能就会后悔。
then: Roman的拇指在他手腕内侧停了一秒，才慢慢松开。

opts.t: Roman低下那一寸，吻在他额头上，然后松开领带。
then: 今天，这是我能给的全部。
Adrian的额头上还留着那一点温度。

opts.t: Roman握住他的手，一根根掰开手指，退后一步。
Adrian往前一步，胸口贴上他。不是撞到，是故意。
then: Roman僵了一瞬，没退，呼吸沉了下来。
Adrian。别因为知道我不能回应，就故意来撩我。
Roman的呼吸终于乱了一拍。他没碰Adrian，也没退。
这两个词的区别，现在越来越没用了。

opts.t: Adrian伸手，碰了碰他锁骨下那道旧疤。
then: 没你现在弄得这么难受。
他握住Adrian的手，从自己胸口拿开，动作轻得过分。

opts.t: Adrian扣住他的后颈，吻了上去。
then: 第一秒，Roman没动。第二秒，他的手掌扣住Adrian腰侧，把最后一点空隙拉没。
他回应了一下，只有一下。短、重。然后强行停住，额头抵着Adrian。
你根本不知道自己在干什么。
Roman睁开眼，目光停在他嘴唇上。

opts.t: 留下。……你愿意留下吗？
then: Roman安静了。这一次，他没有立刻拒绝。
Roman看了他很久，把外套搭到椅背上。
二十分钟。你这次问对了。

zh.title: 卧室门关上之后
zh.teaser: 天黑了，床头灯是房间里唯一的光。他没有走。
then: 窗外的天一点点暗下去。床头灯是房间里唯一的光。
Roman没有走。他站在Adrian面前，近到膝盖碰着膝盖。
Roman抬手，指背很慢地擦过他耳后。十年前，拇指停过的同一个位置。
这里。那天我碰的是这里。
我记得的，比你以为的多。
他弯下腰，一只手撑在Adrian身侧的床沿，额头抵上他的额头。
呼吸缠在一起。谁都没有再往前那半寸。
Adrian没说停。他攥住Roman的衬衫，把人往下拉了一点。
Roman的嘴唇擦过他的嘴角，停住。闭上眼，像在跟自己较劲。
耳机里传来一声：“B区巡检完毕。”
过了很久，Roman才直起身，拇指在他下唇上按了一下。

zh: Roman先退开半步。不是逃，更像把选择权还给Adrian。他整理领带，指尖比平时慢。
如果还要继续这样，我们得有规则。

zh.title: 约束区
zh.hint: Roman把选择权交给你。你定的规则，他以后会照着做。

items.t: 公开场合保持职业关系

then: 你说的暧昧，范围有多大？
Roman认真点头，像在记一条安保条例。
那现在，我可以帮你把领口扣好吗？
你确定要把这条写进规则？

zh: 规则刚定完，Roman去客用浴室冲掉一路的灰。浴室门开的时候，Adrian还是抬了头。
Roman头发湿着，黑T恤被水汽黏在肩上，毛巾搭在颈后。一滴水沿着颈侧滑进领口。
他擦头发的动作慢了，耳尖一点点红起来。

zh.hint: 他抓到你在看。规则里，确实没写这一条。

opts.t: 规则里没写不能看。
Adrian走过去，拿过他颈后的毛巾，替他擦头发。

zh.title: 门铃
zh.txt: 门禁屏幕亮起：SEBASTIAN REED——已验证。

zh: Roman下意识把领带拉正，像在清除证据。
门开了。Sebastian完美得像精心设计过。第一眼看Adrian，第二眼落在Roman身上——不像第一次见。
他走近，替Adrian整理衣领，手指在锁骨附近停了一秒。
Roman没走近，也没打断。垂在身侧的手慢慢握成了拳。
Sebastian的嘴角扬了一下。他不是在碰Adrian，是在测试Roman。

t: sebastian
还是老样子，越在乎越不动。七年了，一点没变。
roman
把手拿开。……我没有资格说这句话。

zh: 他坐下，从公文包里抽出一份协议，推到Adrian面前。
订婚协议。律所、印章、资产条款，做得极其正式。最后一页，签名已经签好：ADRIAN VALE。
Roman拿过文件。看到签名时瞳孔一缩，随即恢复。

zh.title: 他认出了什么
zh.txt: 伪造者知道Adrian以前怎么签名。

zh: 手机震了：你已被拉入群聊“VALE FAMILY”。成员数往上跳，12，18，27。

zh.hint: 没有一个人在欢迎亲人。他们在评估一个新变量。
zh.name: VALE FAMILY

then: Adrian什么都没发。已读的人数一个个跳上去，没人再说话。

items.t: 直接问是谁伪造的签名
then: 群里安静了整整一分钟。Julian那边的“正在输入”，消失了。
Roman看着屏幕，眼神冷了下来。
Adrian拍下那页签名，发进群里，没配一个字。
Roman没说话，看他的眼神变了。

zh.place: 顶层公寓 · 卧室门口

zh: （临走前，在Adrian耳边）你该问问他，七年前去了哪儿。
群里安静得反常。Roman的耳机里传来一句：“东侧楼顶，有反光。”

zh.hint: 你不能告诉他为什么。但你得让他锁上那扇门。

opts.t: Roman看了一眼走廊，离开客厅，拨通了Adrian的电话。
then: 三秒后，Adrian的手机响了：ROMAN来电。他接起来。

opts.t: Roman走到卧室门外，敲了两下。“锁门。现在。”
Roman只发了一条消息：把门锁上。别问为什么。

then: 一个永远冷静的人开始紧张时，恐惧才会传染。

else.hint: 他明明就在同一层。声音少了房间的回响，低得像贴在耳边。
lines: 我知道我在门外。所以才让你锁。
别开窗帘。陌生号码一个都别回。
我就在走廊这头。哪儿也不去。
then: 一个永远冷静的人开始紧张时，恐惧才会传染。
skip: Adrian按掉了电话。三秒后，消息弹进来：把门锁上。

zh: Adrian刚转动门锁，屏幕上方弹出另一条通知。未知发件人。
第三张照片加载出来。Roman站在电梯外，拍摄角度来自一个本不该存在的高处。
红色准星压在他胸口。明天一个人来。否则，你的保镖会先死。
同一秒，Roman的消息弹了出来：你还好吗？
他一整天都在想Roman为什么回来，却没想过，自己会这么快再次害怕失去他。

t: roman
他没回消息。他一紧张就摸左手腕，现在一定在摸。

zh: 这一次的选择，是决定从现在起，要不要把Roman当成自己的人。
en: No lobby, no front desk. The private elevator reads his phone: WELCOME HOME, ADRIAN VALE.
Ding. Floor-to-ceiling glass wall to wall, all of Manhattan in the frame. The living room could hold his old apartment five times.
Adrian doesn't move from the entryway. There's still Brooklyn dust on his shoes. Home. The word costs more than the apartment.
Yesterday I was worried about rent.
Today rent is worried about you.
At the master bath, Adrian steps on a wet tile and his feet go.
Roman catches him from behind: one hand locked on his waist, one arm across his chest, pulling him back against him.
Adrian doesn't move. He leans back, a little.
Two seconds of silence. Roman's ears go red. Someone knocks on the hallway doorframe, and only then does he step back.

en.why: The catch at the bathroom door

en: Once the staff leave, the penthouse is quiet enough to echo. Roman puts his earpiece back in and turns for another sweep.

en.title: New Relationship Goal
en.txt: Get Roman to stay for one conversation he isn't paid for.

en.title: Relationship Goal
en.hint: The one thing money can't buy on the spot has to be him. He's leaving.

then: Can you stay for a minute? Not for work.
Roman stops in the doorway and turns.

then.hint: He asked you to stay. Not for work. Nobody's asked you that in years.

opts.t: ...After I clear the bedroom.
Twenty minutes.
then: Bedroom first. Then the clock starts.

opts.t: Roman takes out one earpiece.

then: Mr. Vale's head of security says he has to clear the bedroom first.
He argues. His feet don't move.
If you leave, who checks the bed?
Roman's ears go red, right on schedule.
items.sub: See if his ears go red

then: I think the bedroom light's broken.

en: I need to clear the room.
The door shuts behind them and the rest of the apartment goes silent. For the first time, it's just them.
Roman takes off his jacket, rolls his sleeves, and checks the window locks, the vents, the bedside lamps.

en.hint: The door is shut. Nobody's coming in. What you didn't finish at seventeen finally has a big enough room.

opts.t: Adrian stands and takes hold of his tie.
then: The silk tightens in Adrian's fist and Roman has to bend his head. The pulse in his neck is easy to see.

then.hint: He has your tie in his fist. One more inch down is all it would take.

opts.t: If I say more right now, I'm going to regret it.
then: Roman's thumb rests on the inside of his wrist for a second before he lets go.

opts.t: Roman closes the inch and kisses his forehead. Then he lets go of the tie.
then: That's all I can give you today.
The warmth stays on Adrian's forehead.

opts.t: Roman takes his hand, opens his fingers one by one, and steps back.
then: There's a crease left in the tie.

opts.t: Adrian steps in until they're chest to chest. Not an accident.
then: Roman goes still. He doesn't back up. His breathing gets heavier.
Adrian. Don't do something just because you know I can't.
Roman's breath finally slips. He doesn't touch Adrian. He doesn't move away either.
That distinction is getting less useful.

opts.t: Adrian reaches up and touches the old scar under his collarbone.
then: Not as much as you're making it.
He takes Adrian's hand and moves it off his chest, far too gently.

opts.t: Adrian takes the back of his neck and kisses him.
then: One second, Roman doesn't move. The next, his hand closes on Adrian's waist and there's no space left.
He kisses back once. Just once. Short and hard. Then he makes himself stop, forehead against Adrian's.
You have no idea what you're doing.
I've had ten years to think about it.
Roman opens his eyes. They go to his mouth.

opts.t: Stay. ...Will you stay?
then: Roman goes quiet. This time he doesn't say no right away.
Roman looks at him a long time. Then he drapes his jacket over the chair.

en.title: After the Bedroom Door Closed
en.teaser: It's dark out. The bedside lamp is the only light. He hasn't left.
then: The sky goes dark outside. The bedside lamp is the only light in the room.
Roman hasn't left. He's standing in front of Adrian, close enough that their knees touch.
Roman lifts a hand and slowly runs his knuckles behind Adrian's ear. The same spot his thumb found ten years ago.
Here. That night, it was here.
I remember more than you think.
He leans down, one hand braced on the bed beside Adrian, and rests his forehead on Adrian's.
Their breathing tangles. Neither of them closes the last half inch.
Adrian doesn't say stop. He fists a hand in Roman's shirt and pulls him down an inch.
Roman's mouth brushes the corner of his and stops there. Eyes shut, like he's fighting himself.
A long moment later Roman straightens, and presses his thumb to Adrian's lower lip.

en: Roman steps back first. Not running. Handing the choice back. He fixes his tie, slower than usual.
If this keeps happening, we need rules.

en.title: Boundary
en.hint: Roman hands you the pen. Whatever rule you set, he'll follow it from now on.

then: Roman doesn't answer. The corner of his mouth moves.
Roman nods seriously, like he's memorizing a security protocol.
Then may I fix your collar?
You're sure you want that in writing?

en: Rules set, Roman goes to rinse off the day in the guest bath. When the door opens, Adrian looks up anyway.
Roman's hair is wet, the black T-shirt clinging to his shoulders, a towel around his neck. A drop of water slides down his throat and under the collar.
His hands slow on the towel. His ears go red, bit by bit.

en.hint: He caught you looking. Technically, that's not in the rules.

opts.t: Looking wasn't on the list.
then: Roman looks up and holds his eyes for two full seconds.

opts.t: Adrian walks over, takes the towel off his neck, and dries his hair for him.
then: Roman goes still and lowers his head and lets him.

en.title: The Doorbell
en.txt: The door panel lights up: SEBASTIAN REED — VERIFIED.

en: Roman straightens his tie without thinking, like he's cleaning up evidence.
The door opens. Sebastian is flawless, like he was designed. First he looks at Adrian. Then at Roman, and it isn't a first look.
So this is the famous Roman.
He steps in and fixes Adrian's collar. His fingers rest near Adrian's collarbone for a second.
Roman doesn't come closer. Doesn't interrupt. The hand at his side slowly closes into a fist.
Sebastian smiles slightly. He isn't touching Adrian. He's testing Roman.

t: sebastian
Same as ever. The more he cares, the stiller he gets. Seven years and nothing's changed.
roman
Get your hand off him. ...I don't have the right to say that.

en: He sits, takes an agreement out of his briefcase, and slides it to Adrian.
ENGAGEMENT AGREEMENT. Law firm, seals, asset schedules, all very official. On the last page, already signed: ADRIAN VALE.
Roman takes the document. His pupils tighten at the signature, then he's back to normal.

en.title: Roman Recognized Something
en.txt: Whoever forged it knows how Adrian used to sign his name.

en: His phone buzzes: YOU WERE ADDED TO: VALE FAMILY. The member count climbs. 12. 18. 27.

en.hint: Nobody's welcoming a relative. They're assessing a new variable.
en.name: VALE FAMILY

then: Adrian sends nothing. The read count ticks up. Nobody types.
Silence is a statement. Not bad.
Three seconds later, Evelyn replies with a period.
(trying not to laugh) Welcome to the Vales.
One full minute of silence. Julian's typing bubble disappears.
Roman watches the screen and his eyes go cold.

items.t: Drop the agreement photo in the group
then: Adrian photographs the signature page and posts it. No caption.

then.title: The Group Goes Silent
then.txt: Twenty-seven members. Not one dares reply.

then: Roman says nothing. The way he's looking at Adrian has changed.

en: (at Adrian's ear, on his way out) Ask him where he went for seven years.
The group stays unnaturally quiet. Roman's earpiece crackles: "East rooftop. Something reflecting."

en.hint: You can't tell him why. But you need him to lock that door.

opts.t: Roman glances at the hallway, leaves the room, and calls Adrian.
then: Three seconds later Adrian's phone rings: ROMAN CALLING. He picks up.

opts.t: Roman goes to the bedroom door and knocks twice. "Lock it. Now."
Roman sends one text: Lock your door. Don't ask why.

then: Fear is contagious when the calm person is afraid.

else.hint: He's on the same floor. Without the room around it, his voice is right against your ear.
lines: Listen to me. Lock your door.
I know I'm outside it. Exactly.
Keep the curtains shut. Don't answer anything you don't recognize.
I'm at the end of the hall. I'm not going anywhere.
then: Fear is contagious when the calm person is afraid.
skip: Adrian declines. Three seconds later, a text: Lock your door.

en: Adrian turns the lock. Another notification drops in. UNKNOWN SENDER.

en.title: YOU SHOULDN'T HAVE COME HOME
en.txt: THE VALE NAME DOESN'T BELONG TO YOU.

en: The third image loads. Roman, outside the elevator, shot from somewhere high that shouldn't exist.
A red dot sits on his chest. COME ALONE TOMORROW. OR YOUR BODYGUARD DIES FIRST.
In the same second, a message from Roman: You okay?
He spent all day wondering why Roman came back. He never considered how fast he could be afraid of losing him again.

en.why: A red dot on Roman's chest

t: roman
He hasn't answered. When he's scared he touches his left wrist. He's touching it right now.

en: This choice decides whether, from now on, Roman is his.

zh: Adrian截屏，发送。三秒后，Roman的电话打了进来。

zh.hint: 他还站在走廊里，站在准星底下。

opts.t: 那你给我进来。
then: 电话那头停了一下。这一次，不是保镖在命令雇主。

opts.t: Roman Cross，你敢死在我门口试试。

zh: 门开了。Roman侧身进来，反手锁门，第一件事是把Adrian从窗边拉开。
他的手还扣在Adrian手臂上，低头看他，呼吸不太稳。
你第一时间就发给我了。
他把手机放到桌上，屏幕上是明晚欢迎晚宴的完整安保方案。
以后你都看得到。所有的。

zh.title: 路线：共同调查
zh.txt: Roman不会再瞒你晚宴的安保方案。

zh.why: 你第一时间把威胁告诉了他

en: Adrian screenshots it and sends it. Three seconds later, Roman is calling.
I know what the photo says.

en.hint: He's still standing in the hallway, right under that red dot.

opts.t: Then get inside.
then: A pause on the line. This time it isn't the bodyguard giving orders.

opts.t: Roman Cross, don't you dare die outside my door.

en: The door opens. Roman slips in, locks it behind him, and the first thing he does is pull Adrian away from the window.
His hand stays on Adrian's arm. He looks down at him, breathing unevenly.
You sent it to me first.
Most people think of themselves first.
He sets his phone on the table. On screen: the full security plan for tomorrow's welcome gala.
From now on, you see everything. All of it.

en.title: Route: Investigating Together
en.txt: Roman won't hide the gala security plan from you again.

en.why: You told him about the threat first

zh: Adrian看着那条“你还好吗”，停了几秒，只回：没事。你回家吧。
Adrian下意识碰了一下左手腕。看到这一幕的，只有他自己。

zh.hint: 他知道你在撒谎。你还想把他推远一点。

opts.t: 晚安，Roman。
then: Roman没回晚安。只发来一句：我上来。

opts.t: Adrian关掉手机，扣在床上。
then: 一分钟后，门外传来脚步声。

zh: Adrian背靠着门，没开。照片里那个红点还在他眼前。
你一紧张就摸左手腕。我不用看都知道。
他的手，确实在左手腕上。
我不走。今晚就坐在这儿。
门外传来布料擦过门板的声音——他真的坐下了。

t: roman
他在保护我。他以为我看不出来。

zh.title: 路线：隐瞒
zh.txt: 等Roman发现威胁，信任会重创——也会第一次知道，你想保护他。

en: Adrian stares at You okay? for a few seconds. Then he types: Fine. Go home.
Adrian's hand goes to his left wrist. Nobody sees it but him.

en.hint: He knows you're lying. You still want to push him further away.

opts.t: Goodnight, Roman.
then: Roman doesn't say goodnight. He sends: I'm coming back upstairs.

opts.t: Adrian turns the phone off and drops it face down on the bed.
then: A minute later, footsteps outside the door.

en: A knock. Three times, very soft.
Adrian leans his back against the door and doesn't open it. The red dot is still in front of his eyes.
You touch your left wrist when you're scared. I don't need to see it to know.
His hand is on his left wrist.
I'm not leaving. I'll sit right here tonight.
Fabric scrapes down the other side of the door. He really sat down.

t: roman
He's protecting me. He thinks I can't tell.

en.title: Route: The Secret He Kept
en.txt: When Roman finds the threat, trust will crack. And he'll learn you were trying to protect him.

zh: Adrian第一次真正用上这部加密手机：VALE安保，最高权限。是否追踪私人号码？

zh.hint: 按下去，内部安保会留下记录。

opts.t: 确认追踪。
then: 地图飞快缩放：不是城外，不是黑市服务器，是VALE大厦内部中继。

opts.t: 先存好截图，再确认追踪。
then: 截图存进三个地方，他才按下确认。地图最后停在：VALE大厦内部中继。

zh: Adrian的表情慢慢消失。威胁不是从Vale家外面来的。
为什么内部安保刚刚标记了你的账户？
“因为这栋楼里有人想让你死。”
我去查中继。你哪儿都别去。
这次不是一个人。你在电话这头，一直别挂。

t: roman
内部中继。能动它的人，一只手数得过来。其中一个，今天刚给我发过语音。

zh.title: 重大线索：威胁来自Vale内部

en: For the first time Adrian really uses the encrypted phone: VALE SECURITY / EXECUTIVE OVERRIDE. Trace private sender?

en.hint: Press it and internal security will log it.

opts.t: Confirm the trace.
then: The map zooms fast. Not out of state. Not a black-market server. VALE TOWER INTERNAL RELAY.

opts.t: Save the screenshots first, then trace.
then: He saves the screenshots in three places before he confirms. The map stops on: VALE TOWER INTERNAL RELAY.

en: The expression drains off Adrian's face. The threat didn't come from outside the family.
Why did Internal Security just flag your account?
"Because someone inside this building wants you dead."
One second of silence on the line.
I'm going to the relay. Don't go anywhere.
Not this time. You stay on the line. Don't hang up.

t: roman
The internal relay. I can count the people with access on one hand. One of them sent me a voice message today.

en.title: Major Clue: It Came From Inside Vale

zh: Adrian盯着准星对准Roman胸口的照片，打了几个字：有种试试。
发送。三秒，对方已读。然后，一张新照片传了过来。
不是Roman。是他和Roman十七岁时坐在便利店门口的那张旧照。
照片背面第一次露出一行字：他本来就不该回来找你。

zh.hint: 对方知道十年前那晚。知道那晚的人，本该只有你们两个。

opts.t: Adrian把照片转发给Roman。
回复：你是谁？
then: 对方没再回。已读，然后头像变成了一片灰。

zh: 门外的走廊里，电梯“叮”了一声。有人上来了——Adrian分不清是谁。

t: roman
那张照片只有一份。我以为它在我手机里。

zh.title: 路线：敌人激进
zh.txt: 危险升级最快，也最早拿到十年前的线索。

en: Adrian looks at the red dot on Roman's chest and types two words: Try me.
Sent. Three seconds. Read. Then a new photo comes through.
Not Roman. The old photo of him and Roman at seventeen, sitting outside the convenience store.
On the back, words he's never seen before: HE WAS NEVER SUPPOSED TO COME BACK FOR YOU.

en.hint: Whoever this is knows about that night. Only the two of you were supposed to.

opts.t: Adrian forwards the photo to Roman.
Reply: Who are you?
then: No reply. Read. Then the profile picture goes grey.

en: Out in the hall, the elevator dings. Someone's coming up. Adrian can't tell who.

t: roman
There's only one copy of that photo. I thought it was on my phone.

en.title: Route: The Enemy Escalates
en.txt: Danger escalates fastest, and the clue from ten years ago comes early.
